title: Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening (S38E03)
keys: treehouse of horror presents the revengening
text: "Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening" is an episode of Season 38 (the 812th episode overall, production code 37ABF13), directed by Eddie Rosas and written by Nick Dahan, originally airing October 18, 2026. Unlike the usual anthology, this Halloween special tells one story. After Springfield imposes a curfew, Homer, Principal Largo, Professor Frink and Superintendent Chalmers get drunk at an abandoned brewery party and then run over a man in a Daft Punk-style helmet while in a self-driving car, and they dump his body off a bridge. A year later, notes reading "Karma" arrive and a killer called Daft Monk begins picking them off, while Marge confesses she also ran over the same man with a boat. Daft Monk turns out to be Apu, who survived a chain of accidents and washed up on the Island of Forgotten Garbage before returning for revenge. Homer offers himself in exchange for everyone else, Apu is moved, and then the Town Hall catches fire. Apu wakes in the Kwik-E-Mart and realizes it was all a dream, and Homer invites him to his Halloween party. The episode marks the return of Apu, who now has a new voice actor, Sunil Malhotra, along with Manjula, voiced by Janina Gavankar. Guest starring Gustavo Dudamel as himself, Janina Gavankar as Manjula Nahasapeemapetilon, and Sunil Malhotra as Apu Nahasapeemapetilon.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXXVII (S38E04)
text: "Treehouse of Horror XXXVII" is an episode of Season 38 (the 813th episode overall, production code 37ABF14), directed by David Silverman and written by Joel H. Cohen, Jessica Conrad and Tim Long, originally airing October 25, 2026. It opens with a stop-motion sequence by Stoopid Buddy Stoodios in which claymation Springfielders sing "Simpsons Halloween". In "Bride's Shed Revisited", every trip into a shed turns Homer into a different husband for Marge, from Lenny to Kang and Kodos to Jeff Probst. In "Dog Boy Afternoon", Homer accidentally kills Bart and Santa's Little Helper, and they come back with their bodies switched. In "Vehicular Dadslaughter", teenage Bart and Lisa find their long-missing father trapped by witch versions of Patty and Selma in endless murderous driver's ed films. Guest starring Tiffany Haddish as Tiffany and Jeff Probst as himself. This installment is made up of 3 segments (also called Treehouse of Horror 37): "Bride's Shed Revisited", "Dog Boy Afternoon", and "Vehicular Dadslaughter".

title: Bride's Shed Revisited (Treehouse of Horror XXXVII segment)
text: "Bride's Shed Revisited" is a segment from "Treehouse of Horror XXXVII" (also called "Treehouse of Horror 37"), which aired as Season 38, Episode 4 of The Simpsons. Homer and Marge celebrate their first anniversary, and when Marge builds the shed Homer promised, Homer steps inside and comes out as a different man: Lenny. Each trip into the shed swaps in another husband, including Chief Wiggum, Dr. Hibbert, Kang and Kodos, Principal Skinner, Moe, Comic Book Guy and finally Jeff Probst. Marge's new best friend Tiffany explains that she's won the romance lottery, since a husband can be replaced at any time. Missing the real Homer, Marge forces him at gunpoint into the shed so the two can be married again, only for Rod and Todd to catch them "sinning" and grab shotguns.

title: Dog Boy Afternoon (Treehouse of Horror XXXVII segment)
text: "Dog Boy Afternoon" is a segment from "Treehouse of Horror XXXVII" (also called "Treehouse of Horror 37"), which aired as Season 38, Episode 4 of The Simpsons. Homer and Bart skip Marge's healthy "beige surprise" dinner by taking Santa's Little Helper out for spaghetti, where the dog is hit by a car chasing a meatball. While burying him, Homer accidentally kills Bart with the shovel and buries them together. A lightning strike raises both, but their bodies are switched. Lisa believes Bart, who is now in the dog's body, after an Ouija board message, and a fight over "BartDog" versus "DogBart" ends with Homer driving Bart to the kennel to be put down. The dogs rescue Bart and kill Homer, who comes back in Snowball I's body, while Bart chases him around the house.

title: Vehicular Dadslaughter (Treehouse of Horror XXXVII segment)
text: "Vehicular Dadslaughter" is a segment from "Treehouse of Horror XXXVII" (also called "Treehouse of Horror 37"), which aired as Season 38, Episode 4 of The Simpsons. Years after Homer vanished, teenage Bart and Lisa notice that a character in their driver's ed film looks just like him. Their search leads to the Department of Motor Vehicles, where evil witch versions of Patty and Selma trap them inside the driver's ed films with Homer, who is killed over and over for his terrible driving. Lisa finds that following every rule in the handbook is the way out, and Bart finally wins by parallel parking without realizing it. Patty and Selma are turned into driver's licenses, and the family is reunited.
